scene.title: The game scene
scene.text: Here you see the game and the characters of the game. You can drag the scene to look around, and zoom in or out with the `+` and `−` buttons.

goals.title: Your level goals
goals.text: These are the tasks you must finish to complete the level. The round mark that beats on the ground is the place the wizard must get to, and a goal is ticked when it is done.

editor.title: The code editor
editor.text: This is where you write your program to control your wizard in the game. You write one instruction on each line, and with them you tell your wizard what to do.

run.title: Run and Restart
run.text: The *Run* button makes the wizard do what the program says. The *Restart* button puts everything back where it started.

notebook.title: The notebook
notebook.text: This button opens the *Notebook*. It lists what the wizard can do, each with an example, and clicking an example puts it right in the editor.

hint.title: The Hint button
hint.text: After a run that did not work, the *Hint* button gives you a clue. A clue costs one of the level's stars.

about.title: The level card
about.text: The `?` button shows the level's starting card again. It reminds you of what the level asks for, and lets you see this guide once more.

method.title: How we learn
method.text: Try, watch what happens, and try again! A run that does not work is how a wizard finds out what to change. Now we are going to write the first instruction.
